sources.title: MiniCPM-V-4_5: Video-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM-V-4_5 is a multimodal large language model built on Qwen3-8B and SigLIP2-400M with 8.7 billion parameters total, created by openbmb. It handles single images, multiple images, and high-frame-rate video understanding on consumer hardware including phones and tablets. sources.title: MiniCPM-V-4_5 · Models
sources.snippet: The model is built on Qwen3-8B and SigLIP2-400M with a total of 8B parameters. It exhibits a significant performance improvement over previous MiniCPM-V and MiniCPM-o models, and introduces new useful features.

sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.5 is an 8B-parameter multimodal model featuring unified 3D-resampling, dynamic OCR, and hybrid RL for efficient image, document, and video processing.
